svg.text: fsnotify → debounce → git diff → LLM router → parallel agents in worktrees → serial integrator

g.text: diff + agent registry (name, description, typical triggers, domain files, avoids when, examples)

svg.text: Phase 3 — Parallel fan-out (agents run concurrently in their own worktrees)
par — Agent A and Agent B run in parallel
file writes, codegen (buf/sqlc/wire), go build/test/vet, go install

g.text: do work, commit on its branch

svg.text: Phase 4 — Serial integration (one MR at a time, FIFO from queue)
loop — process MRs one at a time

g.text: git merge agent-A/uuid into temp worktree
[alt: all pass / validator failed / textual conflict]
[validator failed] LLM repair (1 round build, 2 textual)
[repair failed] requeue Agent A with full context
end loop — pop next from queue

svg.text: Phase 5 — Merge into main triggers next cycle (cascade)

g.text: cycle repeats from step 3 if router identifies follow-up agents
Allow-list (auto-approved, no y/n): file writes, codegen (buf/sqlc/wire), go build/test/vet, go install. Anything else requires explicit y/n from user.
